claims: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will take place in Canada, Mexico, and the United States from June 11 to July 19, 2026.
The Winter Olympics will be held in Italy from February 6 to 22, 2026.
July 4, 2026 marks 250 years since the signing of the Declaration of Independence.
NASA's Artemis II is planned for April 2026.
NASA's Artemis II aims to be the first crewed deep-space mission since 1972.
Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to release on November 19, 2026.
U.S. midterm elections are on November 3, 2026.
U.S. midterm elections will determine control of Congress.
The Lunar New Year is on February 17, 2026.
The Lunar New Year on February 17, 2026 begins the year of the Fire Horse.
In the UK, the national minimum wage is expected to cover roughly 1.70 million jobs by April 2026.
